sections.heading: What is trending: “movie times”
paragraphs: “movie times” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for CA (snapshot taken 2026-11-22T11:25:16+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 100 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from IndieWire, Los Angeles Times, The Guardian. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “David Fincher got to make his own Tarantino movie. First he needed to find himself in it” — Los Angeles Times
“The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth review – Tarantino and Fincher join forces for Brad Pitt’s glorious return” — The Guardian
“If There’s Generative AI in ‘The Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth,’ It’s Not the First Time David Fincher’s Used It” — IndieWire

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Sun, 22 Nov 2026 02:40:00 -0800. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-11-22T11:25:16+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-11-22T11:26:30+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.
